title: payload for capability inbox.resolve
description: Derived from the los CLI parser for this capability's named command. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/generate_capability_schemas.py.

drop_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact drop read: inbox-read's content_sha256 for a file, its drop_sha256 for a folder

name.description: drop name relative to work/inbox/ (list names with inbox-list); one drop, or one file inside a drop folder

routed_to.description: where the drop went (note id, workspace path, source id, receipt id, …); repeatable, at least one required, recorded on the receipt
